name: India Power Plant Outages (SQL)
bullets: Cleaned 1,093 daily CEA outage reports into 165,249 rows in MySQL and checked every day against CEA's own totals
Found breakdowns were 46.5% of the 40.3 GW out per day, and traced most of the 2025-26 rise to one plant's shutdown (17.2, 16.4, 17.9 GW a day without Mundra UMTPP)
Showed CEA's forced-outage column mixes in reserve shutdowns (9.4 GW a day in 2025-26) after a 2025 reporting change, and grouped outages by reason text instead
